result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane signalized intersection with marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the very wide crossing distances and lack of pedestrian refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: Large Turning Radii
hazards.description: Wide corners allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in crosswalks.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and basic sidewalk infrastructure. hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The concrete wall and structure on the left corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks but significant pedestrian exposure due to the long crossing distance. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of mid-crossing refuge islands or curb extensions increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps, providing a basic level of pedestrian access. However, the wide roadway lacks a median refuge or traffic calming measures, resulting in a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a midpoint refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: Absence of a median or island increases exposure time to vehicular traffic.
